title: node-status/v1
description: nodes/<id>/status/<date>-<n>.yaml (F03-Q3): a curator or adjudication record that overrides the derived status (D-8 superseded, D-14/D-33 abandoned, D-18 disputed and stale, D-29 speculative). The latest by date, then file name, wins. Written by F08 and later tooling; F03 only reads them.

cause.description: what the record rests on: a revision request, a dispute id, a superseding node id

reference.description: the superseding node (superseded), the dispute (disputed), or the revoked dependency (stale)
